# Soham Sarkar

> Soham Sarkar (sohamsarkar.com) is a software engineer in Bangalore, India, working across tech, product and design. He is a founding engineer turned technical lead who builds and runs his own products, and offers architecture reviews, technical advisory and career guidance.

Canonical site: https://sohamsarkar.com

## About

Most of his projects start the same way: he runs into a problem, gets annoyed, and builds something to fix it. He ships first and builds things he would use himself.

Current stack: React, React Native, TypeScript, Next.js, Astro on the frontend; Go, Echo, Hono, Bun, Node.js and PostgreSQL on the backend.

Career: founding engineer then technical lead at ZenAdmin (2022 to present), frontend developer at GreedyGame (2021 to 2022), full stack developer at Tellephant (2021).

## Products

- SuperDivide (https://superdivide.com): shared expenses, settled. Create, manage and settle shared expenses.
- Ritua (https://getritua.com): a habit tracker built around streaks, habit scores and planned rest.
- superslate (https://superslate.dev): a source-owned TypeScript SaaS foundation in three editions: React + Hono, TanStack Start and Expo.
- saasclub (https://saasclub.app): a paid product leaderboard where what you pay is your rank.
- TesterSwap (https://testerswap.com): a free exchange where developers install, use and honestly review each other's live apps.
- CTC in Hand (https://ctcinhand.in): an in-hand salary calculator for India, with the new and old tax regimes side by side.
